seed: To avoid the sign-free solver choosing the starting pose, seed only the simulated FK query at current roll +/- pi, choosing the sign with the greater available range (positive on tie), clipped to the measured limits. One seed, no retry. Before commanding a rotation, require guard-checked FK at interpolated joint coordinates (<=5 degrees per shaft/wrist axis and <=0.5 mm insertion per segment). Reject if any queried tip leaves a 0.5 mm ball about its starting pose. No claim of continuous collision certification or real instrument contact.
intervention: After reaching each original last post-closure working observation without changing the prior trajectory, try one CLOSED-JAW reorientation with the tip fixed in place. Use the sign-equivalence of the jaw opening axis already admitted by the original protocol: same directed jaw axis, NEGATED opening axis. This mirrors the curved blades about the working line, not a sensor overlay, deletion or retreat. Use the existing 6-DOF solver, limits, guarded tool_command, unaltered motion budget (one 10-step candidate, no fallback), real grip readback. Refusal is evidence, no forced pose. This is a diagnostic, not a new recovery branch.
evidence: Match source native RGB-D, material state, measured closed TCP and tick before actuation. Record actual TCP pose, closed grip, both grasps, strain, faults, cut events and structure after action. Reject if tip shifts more than 0.5 mm, pointing/negative opening axis differs by >5 deg, jaw opens, any structural links change, any fault/tear, or either grasp lost. Take one native and real frozen 4x exposure, no closure or park. Require explicit RGB-D BELOW at 8 and STOP at 9 (raw AND depth noise) by frozen contact-veto reader on both qualified poses. If the geometry is optically readable but classifier refuses, preserving the observations is not a control pass.
